# SoloMedia - African Culture & Diaspora Platform

SoloMedia is a premier entertainment and content production company specializing in Fashion, Modeling, and Acting for the African diaspora. We bridge the gap between creative talent and global audiences through our digital studio.

## Overview
SoloMedia produces high-impact Film, Documentary, Music, TV series, Radio, and Digital content. We offer flexible access to industry expertise through complimentary foundational courses and premium monthly subscriptions to our curated Lifestyle Magazines.

## Key Topics
- African Fashion & Design
- Arts & Culture
- Music & Entertainment
- Film & Television
- Technology & Innovation
- Investment & Business
- Diaspora Community Stories

## Content Structure
- **Articles**: In-depth stories covering African culture, business, politics, sports, and entertainment
- **Categories**: Organized content by topic (Fashion, Arts, Music, Film, Technology, Investor Relations)
- **Author Profiles**: Featuring diverse voices from the African diaspora
- **News & Updates**: Latest developments in African industries and diaspora communities

## Target Audience
- African diaspora community members
- Creative professionals in fashion, arts, and entertainment
- Investors interested in African markets
- Cultural enthusiasts and researchers
- Media industry professionals

## Unique Value Proposition
- Authentic Afrocentric content and storytelling
- Bridge between African creative talent and global audiences
- Educational resources and industry expertise
- Community-driven platform for diaspora voices
- Focus on sustainable socio-economic growth

## API Integration
The platform is built with a modern tech stack:
- Frontend: Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Sequelize ORM
- Database: Aiven MySQL
- Hosting: Render.com

## Content Guidelines
- Focus on authentic African narratives
- Highlight diaspora success stories
- Provide actionable business and investment insights
- Celebrate cultural achievements and innovations
- Maintain professional, journalistic standards
